mapper.sql: o.*, (o.fee + o.tip) AS total, (o.fee + o.tip - o.commission) AS runner_income, p.tracking_no, p.courier_company, p.status AS parcel_status, p.pickup_code, s.name AS station_name, s.location AS station_location, sh.code AS shelf_code, ru.real_name AS requester_name, ru.username AS requester_username, ru.phone AS requester_phone, rn.real_name AS runner_name, rn.username AS runner_username, rn.phone AS runner_phone, a.auth_code

FROM proxy_order o JOIN parcel p ON p.id = o.parcel_id JOIN station s ON s.id = p.station_id LEFT JOIN shelf sh ON sh.id = p.shelf_id JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.id = o.requester_id LEFT JOIN sys_user rn ON rn.id = o.runner_id LEFT JOIN proxy_auth a ON a.id = o.auth_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO proxy_order (order_no, parcel_id, requester_id, fee, tip, commission, status, deliver_to, note, expire_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{parcelId}, #{requesterId}, #{fee}, #{tip}, #{commission}, #{status}, #{deliverTo}, #{note}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proxy_order WHERE parcel_id = #{parcelId} AND status IN ('OPEN','ACCEPTED','PICKED','DELIVERED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM proxy_order WHERE auth_id = #{authId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

where.if: AND (o.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.tracking_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR ru.real_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR rn.real_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR o.deliver_to ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.update: UPDATE proxy_order SET auth_id = #{authId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE proxy_order SET status = 'ACCEPTED', runner_id = #{runnerId}, accepted_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN' AND runner_id IS NULL AND expire_at > now()
UPDATE proxy_order SET status = 'PICKED', picked_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' AND runner_id = #{runnerId}
UPDATE proxy_order SET status = 'PICKED', picked_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
UPDATE proxy_order SET status = 'DELIVERED', delivered_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PICKED' AND runner_id = #{runnerId}
UPDATE proxy_order SET status = 'DONE', done_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DELIVERED'
UPDATE proxy_order SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = now(), cancel_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('OPEN','ACCEPTED','PICKED','DELIVERED')
UPDATE proxy_order SET rating = #{rating}, review = #{review} WHERE id = #{id} AND requester_id = #{requesterId} AND status = 'DONE' AND rating IS NULL
mapper.select: UPDATE proxy_order SET status = 'EXPIRED', cancelled_at = now(), cancel_reason = '超时无人接单，自动关闭并退款' WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND expire_at <= now() RETURNING *
UPDATE proxy_order SET status = 'DONE', done_at = now() WHERE status = 'DELIVERED' AND delivered_at <= now() - interval '24 hours' RETURNING *

SELECT count(*) AS "total", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'OPEN') AS "open", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('ACCEPTED','PICKED','DELIVERED')) AS "running", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DONE') AS "done", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('CANCELLED','EXPIRED')) AS "closed", count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) AS "today", COALESCE(sum(commission) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DONE'), 0) AS "commission", COALESCE(sum(fee + tip) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DONE'), 0) AS "gmv", ROUND(AVG(rating) FILTER (WHERE rating IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "avgRating", count(DISTINCT runner_id) FILTER (WHERE runner_id IS NOT NULL) AS "runners" FROM proxy_order
SELECT status AS "name", count(*) AS "value" FROM proxy_order GROUP BY status ORDER BY "value" DESC

SELECT u.id AS "userId", u.real_name AS "realName", u.username AS "username", count(*) AS "doneCount", COALESCE(sum(o.fee + o.tip - o.commission), 0) AS "income", ROUND(AVG(o.rating), 2) AS "avgRating" FROM proxy_order o JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.runner_id WHERE o.status = 'DONE' GROUP BY u.id, u.real_name, u.username ORDER BY "doneCount" DESC, "income" DESC LIMIT #{limit}
